scope: Human Activation Review v0.1 Medium findings only

findings.finding: Review packet predecessor validation allowed checkpoint/current-main receipt substitution.
findings.remediation: Require the checkpoint current-main verification binding to equal the supplied receipt by artifact type, artifact reference, and RFC8785-JCS SHA-256 digest; revalidate the same predecessor chain again at decision construction.

findings.finding: Decision JSON Schema did not couple outcome, declaration, typed confirmation, confirmations, safe effect, and positive claim.
findings.remediation: Add conditional JSON Schema branches for approve/defer/reject and negative schema regression vectors.

findings.finding: Decision construction shallowly revalidated the packet and lacked current-main freshness, packet expiry, timestamp ordering, and nonce replay protection.
findings.remediation: Add finite packet TTL, decision-time predecessor reconstruction, explicit current-main observation, ordered timestamps, complete prior-decision history requirement, nonce replay rejection, and single-decision packet rejection.
